newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce sells Parsons to Siemens.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce sells Parsons to Siemens.

text.p: British engineering group Rolls-Royce Plc said on Wednesday it was selling Parsons Power Generation Systems to Germany's Siemens for 30 million stg.
It said in a statement that Siemens will buy Parsons' current aftermarket business, including around 880 employees.

Richard Maudslay, managing director of the Rolls-Royce Industrial Power Group, said, "We are pleased to have completed this major step which ensures a good future for Parsons as a major employer on Tyneside".
Rolls-Royce said in July 1996 that it was withdrawing from the large steam power generation market.
The company also said that it was seeing progress towards the sale of its unit International Combustion, "with several parties expressing strong interest".
